provenance: His son's summary, typed in the Claude Code session on 2026-09-13 after the telephone call that day, of what Larry has said about the mountain across earlier conversations (not dated, not typed at the time). Prompted by Larry's answer that evening that most men avoided going to the mountain and Chapman asked for volunteers. The son's words, verbatim from that message.
text: For Nui Ba Den, in my memory of talking about the topic with my father - he generally says he volunteered for it. He said he liked it on the moutnain, it felt safer and was quieter.
researchNotes: Third-person report, so paraphrase, whatever the source of the facts. It answers what the 2026-09-13 Chapman record left open: postings to the relay site went to volunteers, and Larry, by his own repeated telling, was one. It agrees with his transcribed "I felt safer on the mountain" (Memories, 2026-09-12), and "quieter" is new. A transcribed statement in Larry's own words, if he offers one, would be stronger. Do not ask "did you volunteer?" as a yes/no: he has said it, and a leading question would add nothing. 'moutnain' is his son's keystroke.
